name: bungkus
description: Scaffold full-stack projects with bungkus-cli: a frontend (Astro/Nuxt/Vite) with a batteries-included optional backend (Hono/Elysia + ORM/database, /health-check, monorepo). Translate a plain-language request into the correct `bungkus-cli create` flags, using the tool's own registry as the source of truth for valid options. Also adds tools to an existing project with `bungkus-cli add` and recommends a stack when none is chosen.
